name: Eurostat
tagline: Official EU statistical data API for European economy, society, and environment indicators.
description: Eurostat's public Statistics API provides machine-readable access to official European Union statistics — GDP, inflation, population, labour market, trade, and thousands of other datasets — via JSON-stat and related formats without requiring an API key.

auth.details: No authentication required for the public Statistics API; open access to disseminated data.

pricing.free_tier_limits: Free public access; rate limits apply (see rate_limits)

rate_limits: Published limits exist for bulk/heavy use; verify current thresholds on official API docs
use_cases: fetch EU GDP or inflation time series for a country
compare unemployment rates across EU member states
pull population or demographic indicators by region
export trade or industrial production statistics as JSON-stat
power dashboards with official Eurostat datasets
